Item.Name: PROGRAM_NAME
Item.Hint: Enter the program name or select from LISTVAL.
Item.Label: Program Name

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

 dummy number;
 chk_flg number:=0;
 ins_flg number:=0;

begin
 /* check in the database whether the program name
 entered by the user exists */

 begin
 select 1
 into dummy
 from fcn
 where exec_name=:valid_pgm_win.program_name;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18054'); /* Invalid program name */
 end;
/* Check in the database whether the window and program name
 entered by the user already exists, if so give error */

 begin

 select 1
 into dummy
 from valid_program_windows
 where program_id=:valid_pgm_win.program_name
 and window_name=:valid_pgm_win.window_name;
 
 show_error('18055');
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
 
/* Check in the buffer whether the window and program name
 entered by the user already exists, if so give error */

 check_insert_rg('RG_PGMWIN','C10C10',
 :valid_pgm_win.window_name ||','||:valid_pgm_win.program_name||',',
 'C',chk_flg);
 if chk_flg=1 then
 show_error('18055'); 
 end if;
 
 /* insert the program and window into the record group */

 check_insert_rg('RG_PGMWIN','C10C10',
 :valid_pgm_win.window_name ||','||:valid_pgm_win.program_name||',',
 'U',ins_flg);
 if ins_flg=1 then
 show_error('9199'); 
 end if;
 
end;

Item.Name: EFF_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter the effective date in the format MMDDYYYY.
Item.Label: Eff Date

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* Modified and verified for Y2k...Sobha...07/99 */
begin

 if :valid_pgm_win.eff_date is not null then

 if :valid_pgm_win.eff_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 set_item_property('valid_pgm_win.eff_date',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 else
 set_item_property('valid_pgm_win.eff_date',FORMAT_MASK,'FXMMDDYYYY');
 end if;

 else
 set_item_property('valid_pgm_win.eff_date',FORMAT_MASK,'FXMMDDYYYY'); 
 end if;

end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :valid_pgm_win.eff_date is null then
 show_error('11012');
 end if;
 
 if :valid_pgm_win.eff_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if :valid_pgm_win.term_date is not null then
 if :valid_pgm_win.eff_date>:valid_pgm_win.term_date then
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: TERM_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter the termination date in the format MMDDYYYY.
Item.Label: Term Date

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

if :valid_pgm_win.term_date is not null then

 if :valid_pgm_win.term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115'); /* Termination date cannot be before current date*/
 elsif :valid_pgm_win.term_date <:valid_pgm_win.eff_date then
 show_error('5004'); /* Termination date cannot be before effective date */
 end if;

end if;

end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-DELETE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 del_flg number;
 chk_flg number;
begin
 check_insert_rg('RG_PGMWIN','C10C10',
 :valid_pgm_win.window_name ||','||:valid_pgm_win.program_name||','||',',
 'C',chk_flg);
 if chk_flg=1then
 /* delete the PGM and WIN from the record group */
 
 check_insert_rg('RG_PGMWIN','C10C10',
 :valid_pgm_win.window_name ||','||:valid_pgm_win.program_name||','||',',
 'D',del_flg);
 if del_flg<>0 then
 show_error('9201'); /* delete operation failed while processing
 internal record group */
 end if;
 end if;
 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

begin
 if :system.form_status !='QUERY' then

 check_password(:banner.prog_name,chk_pass);

 if chk_pass='Y' then 
 commit_form;
 if :system.form_status='QUERY' then
 show_error('9163');
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 show_error('9162');
 end if;
end;
